$comment: Website as a Funnel layer 3: the machine-readable tracking-state contract. This is a working, nonbinding inventory of what is observed, what each signal may mean, what completion system is authoritative, and what remains unproven. A null event or join key is an explicit gap, never permission for an agent to invent one. Metrics are evidence snapshots, not permanent requirements.

evidenceWindow.source: marketingsupport/docs/Website as a Funnel Baseline and Build Plan 2026-09-28.md

governance.meaning: Observed events and downstream records may be reported separately. None may be promoted to a governed conversion or GA4 key event until its firing contract, parameters, owner, and completion reconciliation are approved.

video_start.nextStep: Verify video identity, page identity, and exposure denominator before reporting a start rate.

video_progress.currentMeaning: A video crossed one or more progress thresholds.
video_progress.nextStep: Document the progress thresholds and prevent multiple thresholds from being interpreted as unique viewers.

video_complete.nextStep: Join unique completers to unique starters by video and page, then test whether completion precedes an approved next step.

click.nextStep: Do not use as a conversion. Classify destinations and CTA controls first.

event_click.nextStep: Find the GTM trigger and parameter contract before using the event.

file_download.nextStep: Classify file identity and confirm which downloads are approved campus information packets.

popup_cta_click.nextStep: Document the popup, destination, eligibility, and outcome relationship.

workshop_click.nextStep: Locate the trigger and distinguish a workshop content interaction from an event registration.

hubspot_form_submit.currentMeaning: A HubSpot form submission was observed by the alpha.school GA4 property.
hubspot_form_submit.nextStep: Reconcile by host, form ID, purpose, and date against HubSpot before promoting any subset.

community_button_click.currentMeaning: A Community CTA interaction on the instrumented surface.
community_button_click.nextStep: Verify deployment coverage and destination identity before interpreting volume.

book-a-call.doNotInfer: A CTA click, scheduling-page view, or scheduling-form analytics record is not a booked meeting.

info-session.completionAuthority: Event registration system and HubSpot Marketing Event registration
info-session.doNotInfer: An event-card click or registration-page view is not a registration; integrations and event types must be classified before totals are compared.

info-packet.doNotInfer: A generic file_download is not proof that an approved packet was requested, read, or acted on.

application.completionAuthority: Finalsite or the campus admissions system named by the governed destination
application.doNotInfer: A HubSpot redirect-form submission, application-page view, application start, and submitted application are separate stages.

join-community.doNotInfer: A Community button click is not a completed join or interest submission.

knownGaps: No observed GA4 event is configured as a key event.
The GTM container cannot be read by the tested Google account, so firing contracts and parameters remain unverified.
The Google linker currently lists alpha.school only; go.alpha.school and events.alpha.school are missing.
GA4 hubspot_form_submit volume is not reconciled with HubSpot submissions by host, form ID, purpose, and date.
No downstream completion has an approved site-to-system join key or attribution window.
The analytics-and-consent owner and primary prospective-parent outcome are undecided.
